class.name: VGMStreamPlayback
class.description: Created by [AudioStreamPlayer] when playing a [VGMStream]. It has no settings of its own: it applies the settings of its [VGMStream], plus the player's [code]parameters/*[/code] values (see [VGMStream]), whenever they change. Get it from a playing player to react to loops and the fade-out. The end of the song is [signal AudioStreamPlayer.finished]. [codeblock] $AudioStreamPlayer.play() ($AudioStreamPlayer.get_stream_playback() as VGMStreamPlayback).looped.connect(_on_looped) [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] Signals are emitted when the audio is mixed, which is ahead of what the listener hears by about [method AudioServer.get_output_latency].

signal.name: fade_started
signal.description: Emitted when the last loop has been reached and the fade-out begins. [signal AudioStreamPlayer.finished] follows once the fade ends.

signal.name: looped
signal.description: Emitted when the song passes its loop point and starts to repeat. [param loop] is [code]1[/code] for the first repeat. Seeking does not emit it.
